parser_notes: Published by ThriveCart itself about a competitor
subject_exact: Gumroad flat 10% fee's estimated dollar impact at $50,000 annual creator revenue (vendor-authored)
snippet_primary: "Gumroad's flat 10% transaction fee (plus processing fees) effectively penalizes growth. For a creator generating $50,000 annually, Gumroad claims over $5,000 in platform fees alone. In contrast, platforms like ThriveCart, which offer one-time payments, cap these costs, drastically increasing net revenue retention."
